<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Space in pixels between the plot and its labels.
	const TICK_PADDING = 8;
	const plotRight = $derived(ctx.marginLeft + ctx.innerWidth);
	const plotBottom = $derived(ctx.marginTop + ctx.innerHeight);
	// Longest category label that fits beside horizontal bars.
	const maxLabelLength = $derived(Math.max(1, Math.floor((ctx.marginLeft - TICK_PADDING) / (ctx.fontSize * 0.6))));

	/** Shortens a category label that would run past the side margin. */
	function fitLabel(text: string) {
		return text.length > maxLabelLength ? `${text.slice(0, maxLabelLength - 1)}…` : text;
	}

	/** Anchors the first and last labels of a line or area to their edge, so they stay inside the plot. */
	function getAnchor(index: number) {
		// If the categories sit in bar slots: every label centers on its slot.
		if (ctx.type === "bar" || ctx.data.length < 2) return "middle";
		if (index === 0) return "start";
		return index === ctx.data.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle";
	}
</script>

<!-- Gridlines and value labels: across the plot for vertical charts, down it for horizontal bars. -->
<g class="chartGrid">
	{#each ctx.ticks as tick, position (tick)}
		{@const offset = ctx.valueToPixel(tick)}
		{#if ctx.isHorizontal}
			<line x1={offset} x2={offset} y1={ctx.marginTop} y2={plotBottom} />
			<text class="chartTick" x={offset} y={plotBottom + TICK_PADDING} text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="hanging">{ctx.tickLabels[position]}</text>
		{:else}
			<line x1={ctx.marginLeft} x2={plotRight} y1={offset} y2={offset} />
			<text class="chartTick" x={ctx.marginLeft - TICK_PADDING} y={offset} text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle">{ctx.tickLabels[position]}</text>
		{/if}
	{/each}
</g>

<!-- Category labels, thinned so they never overlap. -->
<g class="chartCategories">
	{#each ctx.labels as text, position (position)}
		{#if position % ctx.labelStep === 0}
			{@const offset = ctx.categoryToPixel(position)}
			{#if ctx.isHorizontal}
				<text class="chartTick" x={ctx.marginLeft - TICK_PADDING} y={offset} text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle">{fitLabel(text)}</text>
			{:else}
				<text class="chartTick" x={offset} y={plotBottom + TICK_PADDING} text-anchor={getAnchor(position)} dominant-baseline="hanging">{text}</text>
			{/if}
		{/if}
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* Recessive hairline grid */
	.chartGrid line {
		shape-rendering: crispEdges;
		stroke: var(--border);
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	/* Axis text uses the muted text color, never a series color */
	.chartTick {
		fill: var(--muted-foreground);
		font-size: inherit;
	}
</style>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import { getBarPath } from "./utils.js";
	import type { BarEnd } from "./utils.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Space between touching bars and between stacked segments, so neighbors read apart without a border.
	const BAR_GAP = 2;
	// Widest a bar gets, so bars stay thin marks with air around them.
	const MAX_BAR_SIZE = 24;
	// Share of each category slot the bar group may fill.
	const GROUP_SHARE = 0.8;
	const barCount = $derived(ctx.isStacked ? 1 : Math.max(1, ctx.visibleSeries.length));
	const barSize = $derived(Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_BAR_SIZE, (ctx.bandSize * GROUP_SHARE - (barCount - 1) * BAR_GAP) / barCount)));
	const groupSize = $derived(barCount * barSize + (barCount - 1) * BAR_GAP);
	const bars = $derived(ctx.data.flatMap((_, row) => getRowBars(row)));

	/** Builds the bars of one row; stacked segments step in by the gap, and only the outer end of each stack is rounded. */
	function getRowBars(row: number) {
		const ranges = ctx.ranges[row] ?? [];
		const groupStart = ctx.categoryToPixel(row) - groupSize / 2;
		// The last segment that grows in each direction gets the rounded end.
		const outerPositive = ranges.findLastIndex(([start, end]) => end > start);
		const outerNegative = ranges.findLastIndex(([start, end]) => end < start);
		return ctx.visibleSeries.flatMap((series, position) => {
			const [start, end] = ranges[position];
			// If the value is missing or zero: draw nothing.
			if (!Number.isFinite(end) || start === end) return [];
			const isPositive = end > start;
			const direction = ctx.isHorizontal === isPositive ? 1 : -1;
			// If the segment sits on another one: step it in by the gap.
			const from = ctx.valueToPixel(start) + (ctx.isStacked && start !== 0 ? direction * BAR_GAP : 0);
			const to = ctx.valueToPixel(end);
			const length = (to - from) * direction;
			// If the gap swallowed a tiny segment: skip it; the tooltip and table still have its value.
			if (length <= 0) return [];
			const crossStart = groupStart + (ctx.isStacked ? 0 : position * (barSize + BAR_GAP));
			const isOuter = !ctx.isStacked || position === (isPositive ? outerPositive : outerNegative);
			const roundedEnd: BarEnd = !isOuter ? "none" : ctx.isHorizontal ? (isPositive ? "right" : "left") : isPositive ? "top" : "bottom";
			const d = ctx.isHorizontal ? getBarPath(Math.min(from, to), crossStart, length, barSize, ctx.barRadius, roundedEnd) : getBarPath(crossStart, Math.min(from, to), barSize, length, ctx.barRadius, roundedEnd);
			return [{ id: `${row}-${series.key}`, d, color: series.color, row }];
		});
	}
</script>

<!-- Hover band behind the active row. -->
{#if ctx.activeIndex >= 0}
	{@const bandStart = ctx.categoryToPixel(ctx.activeIndex) - ctx.bandSize / 2}
	{#if ctx.isHorizontal}
		<rect class="chartCursor" x={ctx.marginLeft} y={bandStart} width={ctx.innerWidth} height={ctx.bandSize} />
	{:else}
		<rect class="chartCursor" x={bandStart} y={ctx.marginTop} width={ctx.bandSize} height={ctx.innerHeight} />
	{/if}
{/if}

<!-- One path per bar or stacked segment. -->
<g class="chartBars">
	{#each bars as bar (bar.id)}
		<path class="chartBar" d={bar.d} style:fill={bar.color} data-active={bar.row === ctx.activeIndex || undefined} />
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* Soft band behind the hovered row */
	.chartCursor {
		fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 70%, transparent);
	}

	.chartBar {
		transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Hovered row lifts slightly */
	.chartBar[data-active] {
		filter: brightness(1.08);
	}
</style>

{#each ctx.legendItems as series (series.key)} {@const isShown = !ctx.hidden.includes(series.key)}
    • {/each}

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import { getAreaPath, getLinePath } from "./utils.js";
	import type { Point } from "./utils.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Prefix for the gradient ids, so two charts on a page never share one.
	const uid = $props.id();
	const lines = $derived(ctx.visibleSeries.map((series, position) => ({ ...series, runs: getRuns(position) })));
	const activeX = $derived(ctx.activeIndex >= 0 ? ctx.categoryToPixel(ctx.activeIndex) : 0);

	/** Splits a series into unbroken runs of points, so a missing value leaves a gap instead of a false line. */
	function getRuns(position: number) {
		const runs: { top: Point[]; bottom: Point[] }[] = [];
		let current: { top: Point[]; bottom: Point[] } | null = null;
		for (const [row, ranges] of ctx.ranges.entries()) {
			const [start, end] = ranges[position];
			// If the value is missing: end the current run.
			if (!Number.isFinite(end)) {
				current = null;
				continue;
			}
			if (!current) {
				current = { top: [], bottom: [] };
				runs.push(current);
			}
			const x = ctx.categoryToPixel(row);
			current.top.push([x, ctx.valueToPixel(end)]);
			// Stacked areas fill down to the series below; others fill down to zero.
			current.bottom.push([x, ctx.isStacked ? ctx.valueToPixel(start) : ctx.baseline]);
		}
		return runs;
	}
</script>

<!-- Area washes first, so every line draws on top of them. -->
{#if ctx.type === "area"}
	<!-- One vertical fade per series, used in place of the flat wash when `gradient` is set. -->
	{#if ctx.gradient}
		<defs>
			{#each lines as line, linePosition (line.key)}
				<linearGradient id="{uid}-area-{linePosition}" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
					<stop offset="5%" stop-opacity="0.8" style:stop-color={line.color} />
					<stop offset="95%" stop-opacity="0.1" style:stop-color={line.color} />
				</linearGradient>
			{/each}
		</defs>
	{/if}
	<g class="chartAreas">
		{#each lines as line, linePosition (line.key)}
			{#each line.runs as run, position (position)}
				<path class="chartArea" d={getAreaPath(run.top, run.bottom, ctx.curve)} style:--chart-series-color={line.color} style:fill={ctx.gradient ? `url(#${uid}-area-${linePosition})` : undefined} />
			{/each}
		{/each}
	</g>
{/if}

<!-- Crosshair at the hovered row. -->
{#if ctx.activeIndex >= 0}
	<line class="chartCrosshair" x1={activeX} x2={activeX} y1={ctx.marginTop} y2={ctx.marginTop + ctx.innerHeight} />
{/if}

<!-- One line per series, then its dots. -->
<g class="chartLines">
	{#each lines as line (line.key)}
		{#each line.runs as run, position (position)}
			<path class="chartLine" d={getLinePath(run.top, ctx.curve)} style:stroke={line.color} />
		{/each}
	{/each}
</g>
<g class="chartDots">
	{#each lines as line (line.key)}
		{#each line.runs as run, runPosition (runPosition)}
			{#each run.top as [x, y] (x)}
				{#if ctx.dots || run.top.length === 1 || x === activeX}
					<circle class="chartDot" cx={x} cy={y} r="4" style:fill={line.color} data-active={(ctx.activeIndex >= 0 && x === activeX) || undefined} />
				{/if}
			{/each}
		{/each}
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* Soft wash of the series color under each line */
	.chartArea {
		fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-series-color) 12%, transparent);
	}

	/* Recessive vertical hairline that finds the hovered row */
	.chartCrosshair {
		shape-rendering: crispEdges;
		stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted-foreground) 50%, transparent);
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	/* 2px line with round joins */
	.chartLine {
		fill: none;
		stroke-linecap: round;
		stroke-linejoin: round;
		stroke-width: 2px;
	}

	/* 8px dot with a ring in the surface color, so it stays clear where lines cross */
	.chartDot {
		stroke: var(--chart-surface, var(--background));
		stroke-width: 2px;
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Hovered dot grows a little */
	.chartDot[data-active] {
		r: 5px;
	}
</style>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import { getSectorPath } from "./utils.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
</script>

<!-- One slice per visible row, clockwise from the top; a donut leaves a hole in the middle. -->
<g class="chartSlices">
	{#each ctx.slices as slice (slice.row)}
		<path class="chartSlice" d={getSectorPath(ctx.centerX, ctx.centerY, ctx.holeRadius, ctx.radius, slice.startAngle, slice.endAngle)} style:fill={ctx.rows[slice.row].color} data-active={slice.row === ctx.activeIndex || undefined} />
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* Slice with a 2px gap in the surface color, so neighbors read apart without a border */
	.chartSlice {
		transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
		stroke: var(--chart-surface, var(--background));
		stroke-linejoin: round;
		stroke-width: 2px;
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Hovered slice lifts slightly */
	.chartSlice[data-active] {
		filter: brightness(1.08);
	}
</style>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import { getPolarPoint } from "./utils.js";
	import type { Point } from "./utils.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Space in pixels between the outer ring and the spoke labels.
	const LABEL_PADDING = 8;
	const spokes = $derived(ctx.data.map((_, position) => ({ position, angle: ctx.spokeAngle(position) })));
	const gridRings = $derived(ctx.ticks.filter((tick) => tick > 0).map((tick) => toPoints(spokes.map(({ position }) => ctx.radarPoint(position, tick)))));
	// Missing values sit at the center, so every shape stays closed.
	const shapes = $derived(ctx.visibleSeries.map((series) => ({ ...series, points: ctx.data.map((row, position) => ctx.radarPoint(position, ctx.getValue(row, series.key) || 0)) })));

	/** Writes points as a polygon's `points` attribute. */
	function toPoints(points: Point[]) {
		return points.map((point) => point.join(",")).join(" ");
	}

	/** Places a spoke label outside the chart, anchored away from the center. */
	function getLabelPlacement(angle: number) {
		const [x, y] = getPolarPoint(ctx.centerX, ctx.centerY, ctx.radius + LABEL_PADDING, angle);
		const cos = Math.cos(angle);
		const sin = Math.sin(angle);
		// Labels on the sides hang away from the chart; labels near the top and bottom center on their spoke.
		const anchor = cos > 0.3 ? "start" : cos < -0.3 ? "end" : "middle";
		const baseline = sin > 0.3 ? "hanging" : sin < -0.3 ? "text-after-edge" : "middle";
		return { x, y, anchor, baseline };
	}
</script>

<!-- Grid: one polygon per value tick and one spoke per row. -->
<g class="chartRadarGrid">
	{#each gridRings as points, position (position)}
		<polygon {points} />
	{/each}
	{#each spokes as spoke (spoke.position)}
		{@const [x, y] = getPolarPoint(ctx.centerX, ctx.centerY, ctx.radius, spoke.angle)}
		<line x1={ctx.centerX} y1={ctx.centerY} x2={x} y2={y} data-active={spoke.position === ctx.activeIndex || undefined} />
	{/each}
</g>

<!-- Spoke labels. -->
<g class="chartRadarLabels">
	{#each spokes as spoke (spoke.position)}
		{@const placement = getLabelPlacement(spoke.angle)}
		<text class="chartTick" x={placement.x} y={placement.y} text-anchor={placement.anchor} dominant-baseline={placement.baseline}>{ctx.labels[spoke.position]}</text>
	{/each}
</g>

<!-- One shape per series: a soft wash with a 2px outline. -->
<g class="chartRadarShapes">
	{#each shapes as shape (shape.key)}
		<polygon class="chartRadarShape" points={toPoints(shape.points)} style:--chart-series-color={shape.color} />
	{/each}
</g>

<!-- Dots on every point, or only on the hovered spoke. -->
<g class="chartDots">
	{#each shapes as shape (shape.key)}
		{#each shape.points as [x, y], position (position)}
			{#if ctx.dots || position === ctx.activeIndex}
				<circle class="chartDot" cx={x} cy={y} r="4" style:fill={shape.color} data-active={position === ctx.activeIndex || undefined} />
			{/if}
		{/each}
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* Recessive hairline grid */
	.chartRadarGrid polygon,
	.chartRadarGrid line {
		fill: none;
		stroke: var(--border);
		stroke-width: 1px;
	}

	/* Axis text uses the muted text color, never a series color */
	.chartTick {
		fill: var(--muted-foreground);
		font-size: inherit;
	}

	/* Soft wash with a 2px outline in the series color */
	.chartRadarShape {
		fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-series-color) 12%, transparent);
		stroke: var(--chart-series-color);
		stroke-linejoin: round;
		stroke-width: 2px;
	}

	/* 8px dot with a ring in the surface color, so it stays clear where shapes cross */
	.chartDot {
		stroke: var(--chart-surface, var(--background));
		stroke-width: 2px;
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Hovered spoke darkens to find the row */
	.chartRadarGrid line[data-active] {
		stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted-foreground) 50%, transparent);
	}

	/* Hovered dot grows a little */
	.chartDot[data-active] {
		r: 5px;
	}
</style>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import { getSectorPath } from "./utils.js";
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Rings start at the top and run clockwise.
	const TOP = -Math.PI / 2;
</script>

<!-- One ring per visible row, the first row outermost; each sits on a track that shows the full scale. -->
<g class="chartRings">
	{#each ctx.rings as ring (ring.row)}
		{@const value = ctx.rowValues[ring.row]}
		<circle class="chartTrack" cx={ctx.centerX} cy={ctx.centerY} r={(ring.innerRadius + ring.outerRadius) / 2} style:stroke-width="{ring.outerRadius - ring.innerRadius}px" />
		{#if value > 0}
			<path class="chartRing" d={getSectorPath(ctx.centerX, ctx.centerY, ring.innerRadius, ring.outerRadius, TOP, ctx.radialAngle(value), ctx.barRadius)} style:fill={ctx.rows[ring.row].color} data-active={ring.row === ctx.activeIndex || undefined} />
		{/if}
	{/each}
</g>

<style>
	/* Track in the muted surface color */
	.chartTrack {
		fill: none;
		stroke: var(--muted);
	}

	.chartRing {
		transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Hovered ring lifts slightly */
	.chartRing[data-active] {
		filter: brightness(1.08);
	}
</style>

{#each ctx.series as series (series.key)} {/each} {#each ctx.data as row, position (position)} {#each ctx.series as series (series.key)} {/each} {/each}
{ctx.index}{series.label}
{ctx.labels[position]}{ctx.formatFull(ctx.getValue(row, series.key))}

{#if ctx.tooltip} {@render ctx.tooltip({ index: ctx.activeIndex, label, items })} {:else}

{label}

    {#each items as item (item.key)}
  • {item.label} {item.formattedValue} {#if item.percent !== undefined} {percentFormat.format(item.percent)}% {/if}
    • {/each}
{/if}

description: Bar, line, area, pie, donut, radar, and radial charts drawn with SVG, with theme colors, a tooltip, a legend, and a data table.
